title: FundFusion
tagline: A grants management system that provides a comprehensive solution to manage and track grants efficiently.
description: This  projects combines the power of web2 and web3 to make grants management a painless tasks. The system allows users to check, apply and receive prizes directly in their wallets. The system also ensures administrator enjoys the process of granting to following up on the winners all in one system.
how_its_made:
The projects leverages the power of minipay allowing users to withdraw funds direct to their banks and mobile cash. By using Celo and smart contracts we are able to ensure integrity in the granting process. The app has an intuitive UI ensuring seamless interactions.
Leveraging the power of smart contracts, equal sharing of the prizes among the team members is ensured.
